priorityList: Cast Felblade with Inertia ready (use Fel Rush if Felblade is unavailable).
Cast The Hunt.
Cast Death Sweep.
Cast Immolation Aura if at 2 charges.
Cast Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative, ideally aligned with Eye Beam.
Cast Eye Beam or Abyssal Gaze (ensure Demonsurge procs for Annihilation and Death Sweep are consumed first).
Cast Essence Break while in Metamorphosis, filling the window with Death Sweep and Annihilation.
Cast Metamorphosis when Eye Beam, Immolation Aura, and Death Sweep are on cooldown.
Cast Blade Dance.
Cast Immolation Aura or Consuming Fire.
Cast Annihilation or Chaos Strike.
Cast Felblade.
Cast Throw Glaive or Fel Rush as fillers if no other abilities are available and you are waiting on Fury.
Cast Metamorphosis if you are not currently in Demon Form.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to trigger Inner Demon and enter Demon Form.
Cast Fel Barrage if talented and available.
Cast Death Sweep on cooldown while in Demon Form.
Cast Essence Break if talented, immediately followed by Death Sweep.
Cast Sigil of Flame on cooldown to generate Fury and apply damage over time.
Cast Immolation Aura on cooldown to generate Fury.
Cast Annihilation to spend excess Fury while in Demon Form.
Cast Fel Rush if Unbound Chaos is active.
Cast Chaos Strike to spend Fury when not in Demon Form.
Cast Throw Glaive as a filler if no other abilities are available.
